### Comparison of P1 Critical vs. P2 High Incident Response SLAs (`03_Incident_Response_SLAs.pdf`, p. 1)

Under Clause SLA-SEC-3.1 (Solicitation SOL-2026-SEC-03), the P1 Critical and P2 High incident response requirements compare as follows (`03_Incident_Response_SLAs.pdf`, p. 1):

| Metric | P1 Critical | P2 High | Comparison |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Definition** | Active Ransomware / Root Breach | Privileged Account Compromise | P1 covers active ransomware or root breaches, while P2 covers privileged account compromises (`03_Incident_Response_SLAs.pdf`, p. 1). |
| **Initial Triage SLA** | `<= 15 minutes` | `<= 30 minutes` | P1 requires triage twice as fast as P2 (`03_Incident_Response_SLAs.pdf`, p. 1). |
| **Containment SLA** | `<= 60 minutes` | `<= 4 hours` | P1 requires containment within 60 minutes versus 4 hours for P2 (`03_Incident_Response_SLAs.pdf`, p. 1). |
| **Penalty Credit** | `20% Monthly Fee` | `10% Monthly Fee` | P1 carries double the monthly fee penalty credit of P2 (`03_Incident_Response_SLAs.pdf`, p. 1). |

---

### Required SOC2 Type II and HIPAA Controls (`04_Compliance_and_SOC2_Matrix.pdf`, p. 1)

Under Solicitation SOL-2026-DATA-02, the compliance matrix mandates the following SOC2 Type II and HIPAA controls (`04_Compliance_and_SOC2_Matrix.pdf`, p. 1):

**SOC2 Type II Controls:**
* **CTRL-SOC2-CC6.1:** Requires a **Logical Access Boundary**, implemented via **VPC Service Controls (VPC-SC)** (Mandatory: **YES**) (`04_Compliance_and_SOC2_Matrix.pdf`, p. 1).
* **CTRL-SOC2-CC6.7:** Requires **Encryption in Transit/Rest**, implemented via **Cloud KMS CMEK + TLS 1.3** (Mandatory: **YES**) (`04_Compliance_and_SOC2_Matrix.pdf`, p. 1).

**HIPAA Control:**
* **CTRL-HIPAA-164.312:** Requires **PHI De-Identification**, implemented via **Cloud DLP Streaming Redaction** (Mandatory: **YES**) (`04_Compliance_and_SOC2_Matrix.pdf`, p. 1).

### Comparison of P1 Critical vs. P2 High Incident Response SLAs (`03_Incident_Response_SLAs.pdf`, p. 1)

Under Clause SLA-SEC-3.1 (Solicitation SOL-2026-SEC-03), the P1 Critical and P2 High incident response requirements compare as follows (`03_Incident_Response_SLAs.pdf`, p. 1):

| Metric | P1 Critical | P2 High | Comparison |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Definition** | Active Ransomware / Root Breach | Privileged Account Compromise | P1 covers active ransomware or root breaches, while P2 covers privileged account compromises (`03_Incident_Response_SLAs.pdf`, p. 1). |
| **Initial Triage SLA** | `<= 15 minutes` | `<= 30 minutes` | P1 requires triage twice as fast as P2 (`03_Incident_Response_SLAs.pdf`, p. 1). |
| **Containment SLA** | `<= 60 minutes` | `<= 4 hours` | P1 requires containment within 60 minutes versus 4 hours for P2 (`03_Incident_Response_SLAs.pdf`, p. 1). |
| **Penalty Credit** | `20% Monthly Fee` | `10% Monthly Fee` | P1 carries double the monthly fee penalty credit of P2 (`03_Incident_Response_SLAs.pdf`, p. 1). |

---

### Required SOC2 Type II and HIPAA Controls (`04_Compliance_and_SOC2_Matrix.pdf`, p. 1)

Under Solicitation SOL-2026-DATA-02, the compliance matrix mandates the following SOC2 Type II and HIPAA controls (`04_Compliance_and_SOC2_Matrix.pdf`, p. 1):

**SOC2 Type II Controls:**
* **CTRL-SOC2-CC6.1:** Requires a **Logical Access Boundary**, implemented via **VPC Service Controls (VPC-SC)** (Mandatory: **YES**) (`04_Compliance_and_SOC2_Matrix.pdf`, p. 1).
* **CTRL-SOC2-CC6.7:** Requires **Encryption in Transit/Rest**, implemented via **Cloud KMS CMEK + TLS 1.3** (Mandatory: **YES**) (`04_Compliance_and_SOC2_Matrix.pdf`, p. 1).

**HIPAA Control:**
* **CTRL-HIPAA-164.312:** Requires **PHI De-Identification**, implemented via **Cloud DLP Streaming Redaction** (Mandatory: **YES**) (`04_Compliance_and_SOC2_Matrix.pdf`, p. 1).
